run_trifinger_demo: run the trifinger platform demo with random finger motions and optional camera visualization
create_trifinger_platform: create a TriFingerPlatform instance with visualization enabled and a colored cube object
append_desired_action: append a desired finger action to the platform and get the resulting timestamp
get_robot_observation: get the robot observation including finger joint positions at a given timestamp
store_action_log: store the platform action log to a specified file path
